description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate team focused on patient recovery and well-being.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients in regaining independence in daily living activities. Your role will involve implementing individualized treatment plans, monitoring patient progress, and providing therapeutic interventions to enhance functional abilities.This full-time position offers competitive compensation and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of patients. Join a supportive environment where your skills are valued and professional growth is encouraged.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a COTA
Previous experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA is $28-$37 per hour.
